title: Horror
story: A spooky night where every old house, hat and glowing pumpkin is friendly fun.

cards.name: Pumpkin
cards.subject: A round jack-o'-lantern pumpkin with a short green stem, a carved triangle-eyed grinning face glowing with a bright yellow-white core, and warm orange light cast on the planks around it.
cards.hero_colors: orange pumpkin, green stem, yellow glow

cards.name: Witch Hat
cards.subject: A tall pointed witch hat with a wide round brim, a slightly bent tip and a band around the base with a square buckle.

cards.name: Bat
cards.subject: A bat flying with wings fully spread, two pointed ears, and scalloped wing edges, seen from the front.
cards.backdrop_colors: violet sky turning pink at the horizon

cards.name: Candelabra
cards.subject: A silver candelabra with a round base, a central stem and three symmetrical arms, each holding a candle with a bright fire: a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, and warm orange light cast on the candles.

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.subject: A perfectly round glass crystal ball with swirling white mist inside, resting on a three-clawed gold stand attached beneath it.

cards.name: Lantern
cards.subject: An old black iron lantern with a ring handle on top, a glass-paned body and a bright fire inside: a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, and warm orange light cast around it.

cards.name: Old Key
cards.subject: A large old iron key lying flat, with a round ring head, a long shaft and a notched bit at the end.

cards.name: Grandfather Clock
cards.subject: A tall wooden grandfather clock with a perfectly round clock face with tick marks and two hands, a glass door showing a swinging gold pendulum, and a flat base standing on the floor.

cards.name: Haunted Door
cards.subject: A tall arched wooden front door seen from the porch side, hinges on the left, a round iron knocker ring on the right, a stone step in front and a small round window glowing warm yellow.
cards.hero_colors: dark brown wood, iron knocker, yellow window light
cards.backdrop_colors: rich royal blue night sky with small stars and a crescent moon
cards.surface_or_setting: stone wall of an old mansion with a porch step

cards.name: Haunted House
cards.subject: A tall narrow mansion with a pointed roof, a round turret, a chimney, a front door and glowing yellow windows, standing on a lawn.
cards.hero_colors: dark purple-grey walls, yellow windows, dark roof
cards.backdrop_colors: rich blue dusk sky with small stars and a crescent moon
cards.surface_or_setting: grass lawn in front of the mansion
